parameters.query:
with x as (
  select $1::text as id
), sub as (
  select s.plan, s.status, s.current_period_end, s.topup_balance
  from x left join subscribers s on s.app_user_id = x.id
), today as (
  select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date d
), usage_now as (
  select count(*) used
  from dialog_counts dc, x, today t
  where dc.app_user_id = x.id
    and date_trunc('month', dc.d) = date_trunc('month', t.d)
), bots as (
  select
    count(*) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null) as channels_connected,
    count(distinct bp.bot_key) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null and bp.bot_key is not null)
      + count(*) filter (where bp.deleted_at is null and bp.bot_key is null) as bots_registered
  from bot_profiles bp, x
  where bp.app_user_id = x.id
)
select
  coalesce(sub.plan, 'trial') as plan,
  coalesce(sub.status, 'trialing') as status,
  sub.current_period_end as period_end,
  coalesce(sub.topup_balance, 0) as topup_balance,
  usage_now.used as used,
  bots.channels_connected as channels_connected,
  bots.bots_registered as bots_registered
from sub, usage_now, bots;
